root_cause.description: V3 build_n4_inputs set g9d=p9d (both in POLICY_INTENT_ORDER). Training script train_v23_split.py constructs g9d from individual fields in a DIFFERENT order (TRAIN_G9D_ORDER). This caused raw_logits to explode from [-19,+5] to +/-1.2M, calibration saturation, and high scores at cc=False (model inversion symptom).
root_cause.fix: V4 provider constructs g9d in TRAIN_G9D_ORDER from named semantic dict. p9d unchanged in POLICY_INTENT_ORDER.

schema_unit_tests.details: sentinel order, anti-regression (g9d!=p9d), SHA stability, all-finite, NaN/Inf=0

random_property_tests.details: all 9 field positions verified for arbitrary input distributions

per_field_g9d_statistics.note: constant field is frozen training artifact, not V4 bug

full_1400_replay.reason: Training feature step_records are in CS200 paths. CS200_ACCESS=0 maintained. Schema fix is deterministic (field permutation) and does not require 1400-example statistical proof.

preserved_evidence: Token 31744 semantics (action token alias via clip)

decision.rationale: Root cause is deterministic field-order violation, not model degradation or OOD. V4 restores training schema exactly. 31-parent parity (g9d_diff=0, raw_diff=0) and state36 regression confirm fix. CS200 replay waived due to access boundary — schema is permutation-level, not statistical.
